layout_decisions: Left-to-right request flow: Staff → IAP → API → Pub/Sub → Worker. The push worker is a separate IAM-authenticated service.
Cloud Run, Pub/Sub resources, Cloud SQL, and regional report buckets are within asia-southeast1. Logging and Monitoring are project-level services outside the regional frame.

Cloud Run and Cloud SQL remain managed resources outside the VPC frame. A compact central VPC contains only the Direct VPC egress subnet; API and Worker enter from separate sides after short shared egress stems. Private Services Access uses a compact lower route to Cloud SQL.
API and Worker reach the shared private report bucket from separate sides. The API proxies private downloads; users receive no direct bucket permission.
Cloud Build publishes an immutable image digest; Terraform applies the same digest to Stage and then Production after Stage acceptance.
Stage and Production have separate services, databases, topics, subscriptions, identities, and buckets but share a single-zone Cloud SQL instance as an explicit cost and fault-domain trade-off.
Global Logging and Monitoring sit outside the regional frame. Telemetry routes use the open project header; network and storage connectors use short orthogonal paths without perimeter loops.
IAP is a labeled access gate rather than using the unrelated IAM service icon.
generic_fallbacks: IAP is a labeled generic access gate; no unrelated IAM glyph is substituted.
